judgement.reason: AnythingLLM keeps its core data on local disk: a SQLite Prisma database, a built-in local vector store and ingested document files. Deployz containers start with an empty disk, but the shown lines do not prove that PostgreSQL or S3 cannot replace this storage.

evidence.quote: Out of the box you get built-in agents, multi-user support, vector databases, and document pipelines — no extra configuration required.
runs locally by default with zero setup friction.
